scope: Reusable native preview registration, host-owned geometry, clipped region rendering and Svelte lifecycle through the shared desktop host
build_profile: Cargo test profile, optimized with debuginfo; exact final executables below

regular_tests.command: cargo test --locked -p MapGyver -p golden_assets -p golden_video -p golden_host_desktop --features MapGyver/native-preview-smoke --quiet

readiness_requires: that window output's accepted completion token
preview_native.claim: Control, geometry and native API acceptance; no physical scanout, latency or display alignment claim

app_hardware.command: cargo test --locked -p MapGyver --features native-preview-smoke --test picture_rendering --test channel_rendering -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1

built_fixture_browser.native_adapter: mock metadata only; not GPU evidence

other_checks.source_line_limit: all touched nongenerated Rust/TypeScript/Svelte files below 1000 lines
other_checks.lockfiles: New workspace/dependency edges to already locked versions; no package versions changed

failures_and_corrections.observation: First live native preview run hit the 60-second watchdog without phase reports
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Built browser fixture exposed a real unchanged-DOM-frame acknowledgement race; reconciliation fixed with regression, diagnostics improved, actual native fixture passes
failures_and_corrections.limit: The original timeout alone does not prove its exact cause

failures_and_corrections.observation: An intermediate native run's tool output was truncated
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Outcome not counted; subsequent passing runs retain logs and terminal exit codes

failures_and_corrections.observation: The first resource oracle expected 372 bytes but observed 388
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Shared source-UV uniform grows 48 to 64 bytes; authoritative constant and test charge corrected without changing budgets

failures_and_corrections.observation: The first region pixel run rejected a 4x4 texture in the old 1-2x1 finite readback helper
failures_and_corrections.resolution: Test-only helper now bounds readback to 4x4 and copies each row using native RowPitch; all four hardware tests and strict Clippy pass

acceptance.next: Production source/output/device recovery and bounded retirement, then unchanged Q01/Q02 renderer qualification
limitations: No genuine hardware device removal or sustained qualification pass
Fixed backing projection is not physical-size fidelity or scanout
Default app remains the thin workbench; this fixture consumes generic preview mechanisms
All historical qualification failures and budgets remain unchanged
